caption: QAD of Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 (left) and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (right) at INT4, INT3, and INT2 on Open-PerfectBlend. We show training loss over the full run, the final 1{,}000 steps, and held-out evaluation loss. All losses are forward KL to the full-precision model.
inputs: plotted series of arXiv 2608.13966v2 Figure 3, read back from the figure's own plotting code

processing.train: raw logged train loss (forward KL), steps >= 10; Qwen logged every step is subsampled every 10th; then mean of consecutive pairs -> 20-step cadence (identical to the paper panel; no EMA). zoom panel = same series restricted to steps 3072-4096.
processing.eval: in-loop held-out forward KL every 128 steps from step 128, centered moving average of 3 (paper)

basis_note: In-loop held-out KL (curve basis). Table 1 / Table 4 KL uses a separate fidelity evaluation, so final values differ slightly (e.g. Qwen INT2 QUASAR 0.112 in-loop vs 0.126 in the tables).
